# Papilio — Complete Knowledge & Agent Context

> A cozy, aesthetic, premium patisserie-café in Excise Colony, Hanamkonda, Warangal. Established October 2023. Rated 4.3★ by 1,300+ diners.

## Overview
Papilio is Warangal's premier patisserie-café, blending French pastry techniques with modern European café dining. Founded in October 2023 in Excise Colony, Hanamkonda, it offers a tranquil cream-and-espresso aesthetic with indoor air-conditioned dining, outdoor seating, and takeaway.

## Business Details
- **Brand Name:** Papilio (Wordmark: PAPILIO)
- **Tagline:** Patisserie | Café
- **Address:** H.No. 2-7-741, Excise Colony, Hanamkonda, Warangal, Telangana 506370, India
- **Phone:** +91 90003 16366
- **WhatsApp:** https://wa.me/919000316366
- **Operating Hours:** 8:00 AM – 10:30 PM (Monday to Sunday)
- **Price For Two:** ₹800 for two (dine-in), ₹250 for two (delivery)
- **FSSAI License:** 23626018000482
- **Amenities:** Dine-in, Takeaway, Delivery, Parking, Wheelchair accessible, Card/UPI payments accepted

## Menu Highlights & Signature Dishes
- **Chicken & Avocado Salad (₹376):** Grilled chicken breast, ripe avocado, fire-roasted peppers, cherry tomatoes, and fresh herbs in a roasted-pepper vinaigrette.
- **Buttermilk Chicken Wrap (₹391):** Crispy buttermilk-marinated chicken, crunchy seasonal vegetables, and spicy cheese sauce in a toasted tortilla, served with fries.
- **Cottage Crunch Wrap (₹335):** Crispy spiced paneer cottage cheese, crisp lettuce, red onions, and sriracha-cheese sauce, served with golden fries.
- **Double Trouble Chicken Burger (₹390):** Two crispy spiced chicken patties, cheddar cheese, pickled jalapeños, chipotle mayo, and skinny fries with cheese dip.

## Patisserie & Cakes
- Fresh counter desserts baked daily including fruit tarts, chocolate eclairs, cheesecakes, and tea cakes.
- Custom celebration cakes made to order with 24–48 hours notice.
- Curated dessert gifting boxes for festivals, birthdays, and corporate events.
